reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "loki do not wrap requests but send pure Protobuf from frontend v2 via scheduler to querier when `-frontend.encoding=protobuf`. 10956", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Requests from frontend v2 to querier via scheduler are now transmitted as pure Protobuf instead of wrapped when -frontend.encoding=protobuf is configured.

proposed.statement: When -frontend.encoding=protobuf is set, Loki frontend v2 now sends pure Protobuf requests through the scheduler to the querier instead of wrapping them.
